Class ProducerSessionPool

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.jms.pool.ProducerSessionPool
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ProducerSessionPool extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Reuses the sessions of producers across sends, instead of opening a connection and a session for each message. The sessions are created on one connection from the connection factory of a JMSConnectionPool, which this pool opens on the first send and closes with itself. A session is used by one send at a time, and a session that failed is closed rather than reused. At most maxActive sessions are borrowed at once, of all session modes: when all of them are borrowed, a send waits up to maxWait for one to be released.

A session released while sends are waiting is kept for them, so a burst of sends reuses at most maxActive sessions of each session mode instead of closing and opening sessions. Once no send waits, a released session is closed if maxIdle sessions of its mode are idle already, and a periodic check closes the oldest idle sessions above maxIdle that remain, for example sessions kept for a send that took one of another mode.

When a session cannot be created, or the provider reports a failure of the connection to its ExceptionListener, the connection is replaced. Its idle sessions are closed, its borrowed sessions are closed when they are released, and the connection is closed once the last of its sessions is.

Since:
5.2.0
